prompt: Image 1 is a POSING GUIDE: one mannequin standing in an A-pose, shown five times from five angles, left to right: (1) from straight in front, (2) three-quarter front, facing the viewer's left, (3) pure side view facing the viewer's left, (4) three-quarter back, (5) from straight behind. On the mannequin, red marks the figure's own RIGHT arm and leg, blue its LEFT. Image 2 is the character design: Juno, a 15-year-old girl: tan skin, short choppy teal hair with one long side lock hanging in front of her right ear, a small scar through her left eyebrow, round brass flight goggles pushed up on her forehead, chunky headphones resting round her neck, an orange cropped flight jacket with a high stand-up collar worn open over a navy shirt, the jacket sleeves pushed up to the elbows, three plain geometric patches on the jacket (a circle, a square and a triangle in flat colours, no emblems, no text), dark-grey baggy cargo trousers with a cream stripe down the outside of each leg and a cargo pocket on each thigh, red-and-white high-top trainers with no logo, brown fingerless gloves. Image 3 is the style reference. Make a character turnaround model sheet: paint the character from image 2 over each of the five mannequins, at exactly the same position, size, pose, proportions and viewing angle as the mannequin under it, so the five drawings are the same girl turning on the spot. Identical outfit, identical colours and identical details in all five views; the long side lock and the patches stay on the same side of HER body in every view. Arms held slightly away from the body, hands empty and relaxed, no hoverboard, no props. Calm neutral expression, mouth closed. Plain pure white background, no ground shadow, no text, no labels, no numbers, nothing of the mannequin left visible. Style: 1990s hand-painted cel anime, exactly like the style reference: clean black ink outlines of even weight, flat colour fills, exactly two tones per material (a base and one hard-edged shade), no gradients, no texture, no soft shading, no highlights bloom. No brand logos, no text, no letters, no emblems anywhere.
